title: Five hundreds
hints: README → New syntax: `-E` and `{n}` repetition. The status sits right after the request's closing `"`.
Match: the closing quote, a space, `5`, exactly two more digits, a space. The spaces stop it matching inside sizes or IPs.
`grep -E '" 5...' "$DATA/access.log"`: replace `...` with a digit class repeated twice, then a space.
